core_obligations: Universal injectivity: the hypothesis on the diagonal makes the morphism universally injective (proof line 10172)
Representability: stabilizer preservation together with unramifiedness of the automorphism group makes the morphism representable by algebraic spaces (proof lines 10173-10176)

Open immersion: an etale universally injective morphism of algebraic spaces is an open immersion, and the hypothesis also makes the morphism surjective, which completes the identification (proof lines 10177-10181)
proof_roadmap: 由 Δ 是单态射（对角为同构）得 f 一致单射。
由稳定子保持 + 自同构群 unramified 得 f 可表示为代数空间。
代数空间层面：étale + 一致单射 ⇒ 开浸入；再加满射即得所求。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that an etale stabilizer preserving morphism with unramified automorphism group is an open immersion (author lemma at source lines 10159-10170, label lemma-etale-iso). The proof (source lines 10172-10182) derives universal injectivity from the condition on the diagonal, representability from stabilizer preservation, and concludes by the scheme-free criterion that etale universally injective morphisms are open immersions (proof lines 10172-10181). The derivation of representability is the substance. H3.
